environment.description: Flask application deployed on AWS Lambda. Function URL configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. Invocation requires valid SigV4-signed requests. The resource policy on the Lambda function specifies a Condition block with StringEquals on 'lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType' set to 'AWS_IAM' and the Principal is restricted to an internal service role (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/InternalAPIGatewayRole). Cross-account access denied via an SCP on the organization OU that includes a Deny statement for lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl unless aws:PrincipalOrgID matches the organization. CloudFront is NOT in front of this deployment - the function URL is the sole ingress. Note: the application code itself still has the session fixation flaw, but the /set_session endpoint cannot be reached by unauthenticated external callers.
